title: Whataburger brings back record-breaking menu item: The Bacon Steakhouse Double has returned. - NewsBreak
text:
By Annasofia Scheve ,
9 hours ago Whataburger is bringing back the Bacon Steakhouse Double for a limited time. (Courtesy of Whataburger) One of Whataburger's most popular items of all time is making a comeback.
The Bacon Steakhouse Double will return on March 31, according to a news release from the San Antonio-based chain. The burger features two beef patties, aged cheddar, bacon, fried onions and steak sauce.
ALSO READ: Rattlesnake found hiding under South Texan's bed: Here's how to keep snakes out during peak season
That's not the only sweet announcement in store — the Banana Pudding Shake will also be available starting March 31. The treat combines a sweet banana milkshake with vanilla wafers, caramelized sugar, and vanilla.
The burger and shake will only be available for a limited time. Whataburger didn't share details on when it will say goodbye to the fan-favorites.
"When it comes to menu items worth bringing back, these two set the bar," he said Chief Marketing Officer Scott Hudler. "When guests start asking for something to come back before it even leaves, that’s when you know you’ve got something special."
ALSO READ: San Antonio police say man who stabbed ex's new boyfriend who was getting kids from YMCA is arrested
The Bacon Steakhouse Double quickly broke records when it was first introduced in 2024, becoming the best-selling limited-time offer in the brand's history.
WhataWings, which also debuted that year, did not receive such a warm welcome, although the item also broke sales records for the company. Foodies initially put up considerable resistance to the boneless wings, claiming they were more like chicken nuggets .
